subject.title: [Feature]: Preview applied Skill Workshop proposals before approval

question: Should exact proposal preview and optional proposal-version checking become part of the core Skill Workshop approval contract?
rationale: The preview fits the existing core owner boundary, but it adds a new operator-facing tool action and approval invariant whose permanent API semantics require feature-owner intent.

options.title: Adopt optional binding
options.body: Land canonical preview plus optional proposal-version checking while preserving all existing proposal-ID-only apply calls.

options.title: Preview only
options.body: Add exact review output now but defer any apply-contract change to separate work.

options.title: Keep current flow
options.body: Retain metadata inspection and summary-only approval without an exact preview action.

recommendation.title: Adopt optional binding
recommendation.body: Land canonical preview plus optional proposal-version checking while preserving all existing proposal-ID-only apply calls.

likelyOwner.reason: The current core Skill Workshop implementation appears to originate from their commit across the service, policy, persistence, tool, and tests.
